beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Improved sample comparison controls to make them clearer and allow deleting either sample.
• Added preferred student names to work sample verification and paperwork.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Review and grading share a compact document toolbar with Undo, page editing, and zoom controls. Sample comparison offers clearer choices to replace, keep, or delete samples.
• New samples use a four-square header, with six-square available in Settings. Task text can be previewed before adding it to a sample.
• Preferred student names appear in verification, sample headers, progress-grid searches, and paperwork. Roster sync lets you review incoming changes.
• Folder recovery provides clearer choices when your work folder is temporarily unavailable, and setup explains folder and connection choices.
• Schoology samples can be filed and managed directly from course activity. Learning-period to-dos are grouped by workflow stage, and Mac updates show clearer preparation and installation progress.

Fixes:
• Fixed Schoology files failing to open after downloads, stale Missing indicators, and missing-work refresh. Sample replacement supports undo and keeps review tied to the selected course and learning period.
• Fixed incoming and manually assigned samples losing source files or being overlooked as duplicates. Corrected work sent with the same filename now reaches review.
• Failed AI analysis offers recovery or manual review, preserves existing grades and feedback, and no longer supplies fallback full credit.
• Fixed incoming-sample comparison badges and page-selection issues during rotation. Work sample filing validates dates against the active learning period.
• Mac installers include a verified browser bridge and stronger packaging checks. Crash reports redact email addresses and student names in known breadcrumb formats.
• Closing AI settings while a model capability check is running no longer causes a late-callback error.
